tools.name: search_free_materials
tools.description: Searches CandidateFalcon public courses, lessons, interview questions, articles, and comparisons and returns matching titles, descriptions, source URLs, and IDs for read_free_material. An empty query lists all materials. Supports offset/limit pagination (limit 1-20).

tools.name: read_free_material
tools.description: Returns the text of one public CandidateFalcon material by the ID from search_free_materials, with its title and source URL. Long texts are paginated by character offset (limit up to 12,000 characters); nextOffset is null on the last page.

tools.name: open_hirevue_game
tools.description: Shows an interactive CandidateFalcon practice game modeled on a HireVue game-based assessment. Available games: Numerosity, Flashback, Pathfinder, Digitspan, Puzzle Picture, Portrait, PortraitXT, Shapedance, E-Motions, Singularity, Teamchat. Without a game, shows a game picker. tools.name: get_game_results
tools.description: Returns the connected user's recent completed practice results from the website and from chat, newest first: game, score, rounds, duration, correct/incorrect/skipped counts, date, and where it was played. Optional game filter; limit 1-20 (default 10).

tools.name: start_game_session
tools.description: Creates a new practice session record for the connected user when a game starts in the interface, and returns its ID. Limited to 5 new sessions per minute per account.

tools.name: save_game_result
tools.description: Saves the final result of a session created by start_game_session and marks it completed. Each session is saved once; later saves are ignored. Sessions expire 2 hours after they start, and the saved duration is capped at the session's real age.
